schemaNotice: 專案能力契約，非 B4A 原生 schema；由已審閱的靜態 factory 註冊，不從匯入檔執行元件或程式。雜湊只核對來源一致性，不代表安全或視覺驗收。
name: TourViewport
dependencies: B4A BasicButton, Heading, Text, Dropdown, UploadButton, TextInput, ModalPanel

registration.factory: TourPage.mount explicitly registers the B4A component allowlist and TourViewport; ModalPanel supplies confirmation dialogs. Unknown component names reject.
registration.sourceTrust: Reviewed local implementation and fixed same-origin page definition only.
reject: arbitrary executable manifests or JavaScript from input
unknown schema fields and invalid entity references
remote resource URLs in embedded project assets

inputs.file: User-selected lumiere-building JSON; supported legacy single-level JSON migrates via parseBuilding. Complete lumiere-project v2 .lumiere bundles use prepareBundle.
inputs.handoff: Validated building or complete project bundle, deep-copied in module memory by stageTourHandoff. Designer captures a full bundle before navigating.
inputs.editorReturn: Separate original source snapshot plus editor-owned saved state, undo/redo, frame history and edit preferences. A clean exit restores the original snapshot. Dirty exit stages the validated edited full bundle. Original editor history merges only while touring that editor source; a successfully loaded replacement returns its own baseline/history, never another source's history/assets. Failed/cancelled replacement retains source association.

outputs: 3D reality tour with a full scene, upper-left 2D map and upper-right B4A function controls
first-person walk with existing collision, stair and elevator navigation
B4A hold-to-move and hold-to-turn controls on narrow screens or coarse pointers, using the same walk collision logic
blinking map position marker, persistent front-facing arrow, automatic walked-floor map/underlay follow and left-double-click floor teleport
selection details and grouped manual labels, including relative height and observer distance
validated local object placement, deletion, position/elevation/rotation/size updates, undo and redo
door/window and available appliance/switch operation within the tour copy
explicit local JSON/full-project download; exit transfers dirty edits to the designer while clean exit restores the original snapshot
text status for loading, cancellation, rejection and navigation

authority.read: User-selected local files or an explicitly staged in-memory editor snapshot.
authority.write: Tour-owned validated building/history state and explicit local downloads. Exit with dirty edits or apply-and-exit may stage an edited full bundle for the designer. No source-file overwrite, localStorage draft write, database, identity or permission mutation.
authority.network: Same-origin application modules, page definition and existing packaged dependencies only. No file upload, cloud reconstruction API or remote asset resolver.
authority.navigation: Existing application router routes #/tour and #/design. Editor return is consumed by DesignerPage; it is not persisted across document reloads.

editing.target: Registered furniture/equipment objects on an explicitly selected floor; openings expose their existing open-state operation.
editing.validation: Candidate building and imported asset budgets validate before a single store/history commit; arbitrary command names or transform fields are not accepted by the tour UI.
editing.restrictions: Host-attached transforms and semantic assembly object changes require the main designer. No arbitrary script execution or asset URLs.

material.validation: Shared target restrictions, immutable registered IDs, evidence/relationship locks and imported asset budgets; one undo entry
material.persistence: Material IDs save in building JSON; custom maps require complete bundle

limits.embeddedAssets: Existing project-bundle validation budgets remain authoritative; passing the file-size limit alone is insufficient.
limits.geometry: Existing building/model validation limits apply; this is not an unrestricted generic JSON or CAD viewer.

errors: Input is validated and prepared before replacing the active tour. Invalid, cancelled or superseded loads preserve the current scene; stale prepared assets are disposed. Unsupported walk starts keep orbit viewing available.

lifecycle.mount: Fetch fixed local definition, instantiate trusted B4A renderer, mount scene/map, consume one pending viewer handoff.
lifecycle.update: Load requests supersede and abort earlier requests. Whitelisted TourEditor commands validate the entire candidate before replacing the tour building and one undo step. Map position/facing uses the existing 2D overlay. While walking, a changed observer floor switches only map floor/underlay/fit without stopping the walker or adding edit history; source replacement associates history only after successful load.
lifecycle.destroy: Idempotently cancel loads, release held touch/keyboard movement, cancel turn RAF and activation pulses, remove page listeners, release prepared GLB/material/underlay/IFC resources and destroy both viewports including RAF, blink timer, WebGL resources and observers.

limitations: Responsive browser navigation with touch movement controls; this page does not expose an immersive WebXR/headset session. Emulated narrow-screen checks do not certify physical phones.
Walkability depends on modeled floor surfaces, openings and connections. A visible model can remain orbit-only when no valid walking start exists.
Raw building JSON carries geometry/settings, not separately imported GLB files, textures or source images; use a complete project bundle for embedded resources.

Object editing is limited to registered assets and allowed transforms. Attached or semantic assembly objects may require the main designer; no wall/room topology editing, local video/YouTube playback, automatic reconstruction or source-photo comparison UI.
Source reference, capture, sheet and structural-analysis data may be validated as part of a full bundle; their editing/review interfaces remain in the designer.

Clean exit restores the original editor snapshot; dirty exit stages the edited bundle into the designer's in-memory model. Refreshing the page clears the transient handoff. Downloads do not overwrite the user-selected source file or local draft.
verificationScope: Tests cover strict import, cancellation/disposal, original and edited handoff, cross-source history/asset separation, non-editing navigation gestures, explicit object commands, floor provenance/follow, initial sizing, heading projection and touch movement/collision/input-release cleanup. Browser visual checks and real-device/headset validation are separate.
rollback: Remove the #/tour route and its explicit navigation entry to disable the additive viewer; retained designer controls and existing residence route remain independent. Imported source files are never overwritten.

viewing.framing: Effective FOV/aspect and visible native subject bounds, with floor fallback and clipping-safe far/max distance.
viewing.manualLabels: B4A toggle; world text remains visible.
viewing.detail: full preview also sets streetMode full

desktopMovement.longitudinal: W/ArrowUp and labelled forward move along current horizontal camera facing. S/ArrowDown and labelled backward move opposite. Same semantics in both residence and native designer/tour.
desktopMovement.touch: Same direction semantics as keyboard; existing shared input mechanism.
